title: Gen AI Engineer
summary: Builds products on large language models: prompting, retrieval (RAG), fine-tuning, agents, evaluation and safe deployment.
whatYouDo: Turn a fuzzy product idea into an LLM feature that works reliably
Design prompts, retrieval and tool use, then measure quality with evals
Ship, monitor cost and latency, and keep outputs safe

stages.title: Foundations
stages.goal: Write clean Python, use Git and call web APIs with confidence.
stages.project: A command-line tool that calls a public API and saves results as JSON.

stages.title: How LLMs work
stages.goal: Explain tokens, context windows, sampling and why models hallucinate.
stages.project: A notebook comparing three models on the same 20 prompts: quality, speed and cost.

stages.title: Prompting & LLM APIs
stages.goal: Build reliable LLM calls with structured output and streaming.
stages.project: A support-ticket triager that returns validated JSON (category, urgency, summary).

stages.title: RAG & retrieval
stages.goal: Ground model answers in your own documents, with sources users can check.
stages.project: Chat with your PDFs: answers over 20+ documents with page citations.

stages.title: Fine-tuning & open models
stages.goal: Know when to fine-tune, and run or adapt an open model yourself.
stages.project: LoRA-tune a small open model on a narrow task and beat its base version on your eval.

stages.title: Agents & tools
stages.goal: Build agents that plan, call tools and recover from mistakes.
stages.project: A research agent that searches, reads and writes a cited brief, with a step log.

stages.title: Production & evals
stages.goal: Ship LLM features that are measured, monitored, affordable and safe.
stages.project: Deploy your RAG app with an eval suite in CI, tracing, and a cost dashboard.
